verdict.rationale: The Terms state users can opt out of having their Materials used to train AI models via app.instinct.com/settings, and that anything placed in the Vault is never used for training. Community screenshots of the original 'perpetual and irrevocable' license, which covered model training, raise concern but do not show the opt-out failing, so they lower confidence rather than create a dispute. Missing for 10: confirmation that conversations specifically count as 'Materials', any detail on the settings control itself (it appears to be opt-out with training on by default), and independent or hands-on verification that the opt-out works.
